candidates.name: Gastric Phycomycosis
support_spans: abdominal ultrasound revealed multiple rounded, echogenic neoformations at the pyloric antrum
cytological brushing of the gastric mucosa demonstrated mucosal cells, mixed neutrophilic and macrophagic inflammation, and occasional large, non-septate hyphae with irregular diameter and branching
candidates.why: The presence of non-septate hyphae and echogenic neoformations in the pyloric antrum suggests a fungal infection.
